He Who fulfilled the dispensation for us...

invocations.normalized_rubric: *On the 26th day: The Falling-Asleep of the Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian. We celebrate the great day. All-Night Vigil. We sing stichera on 8, Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the Heavenly Ranks" (Небесных чинов): Glory, Tone 2: "Son of Thunder"; Both now, Theotokion: "The shadow of the Law has passed away"; Entrance, prokeimenon of the day, and 3 readings from the Catholic Epistle of John: "Beloved, if our heart condemn us not..." [1 Jn. 3:21–4:6]; "Beloved, [if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another]..." [1 Jn. 4:11–16]; "Beloved, [if a man say, I love God, and hates his brother, he is a liar]..." [1 Jn. 4:20–5:5].*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *...and if anyone [say]: thus indeed 13 readings. Then the...

invocations.normalized_rubric: *On the 27th day: The Holy Martyr Callistratus and his Companions. At "Lord, I have cried", stichera of the saint, Tone 4, samoglasny: "Of Thy most precious Cross..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion: "Thy martyrs, O Lord". At Matins: After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Hast Appeared Today" (Явился еси днесь):*[^227]
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

At the Aposticha, of the feast; Glory, Tone 8: "And repentance likewise..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion: "With the streams of thy tears..." [written on the 3rd of this month]. At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos, and of the saint on 4. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "The Firm and God-Proclaiming Preachers" (Твердыя и боговещанныя проповедатели):*[^228]
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

At the Aposticha, of the Octoechos; Glory, of the saint; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion: "And having been a partaker of the ways..." [written on the 3rd of this month]. At Matins: Canons of the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6. After Ode 3, Kontakion, Tone 6, Podoben: "Fulfilling the Dispensation for Our Sake" (Еже о нас):*
invocations.prescribed_model: Fulfilling the dispensation for our sake

invocations.normalized_rubric: *At Matins: The customary psalmody, and canon of the Octoechos, then of the saint; Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi] of Tone 4. Prokeimenon: "My mouth shall speak [wisdom]" [LXX Ps. 48:4]; Verse: "Hear this, all ye nations" [LXX Ps. 48:2]. Let every breath. Gospel from John, Thursday of the 5th week [Jn. 10:9–16], ending: "about the middle". Psalm 50. Sticheron of the saint. Canon of the Theotokos: "Held fast by many [temptations]...", with the heirmos on 6; and of the saint on 8. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 6, Podoben: "Fulfilling the dispensation for our sake" (Еже о нас):*
invocations.prescribed_model: Fulfilling the dispensation for our sake
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *On the 14th day: The Holy Apostle Philip; we celebrate all day. At Vespers: Stichera on 6; 3 and 6 "All my hope..."; Glory, Tone 6: "Of the heavenly [choirs]..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: of the Octoechos; Glory, Tone 2: "Having left [earthly things]..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion: "O holy Apostle...". At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 8, Podoben: "As first-fruits of nature" (Яко начатки):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *On the 21st day: The Entry into the Temple of our Most Holy Lady the Theotokos. We celebrate all day, singing an All-Night Vigil, and Small Vespers Stichera of the feast, 3, Tone 1, on 4: "O marvelous wonder"; Glory... Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: of the feast, 3, Tone 2, Podoben: "O House of Ephratha" (Доме Евфратовъ); and we say the verses: "The virgins shall be brought unto the King after her" [LXX Ps. 44:15]; "They shall be brought in gladness and rejoicing" [LXX Ps. 44:16]; Glory... Both now, what they wish. Troparion, Tone 4:*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Troparion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man". Stichera on 8: we sing 3, Tone 1: "O marvelous wonder", the first twice; and other 3, Tone 4, Podoben: "As Noble" (Яко добля), the first twice; Glory... Both now, Tone 8: "After Thy birth...". Entrance; 3 Paremias of the feast. At the Litiya, Idiomela of the feast; Glory... Both now, Tone 2: "All ye earth-born...". At the Aposticha we sing 3, Tone 5; and we say the verses even as at Small Vespers; Glory... Both now, Tone 6: "Today the assemblies of the faithful..."; blessing of the loaves.[^280]*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *The Troparion of the feast is said thrice, Tone 4: "Today is the prelude of the good will..."; and the homily of the feast is read. At Matins: the customary psalmody [Kathisma], and the other prayers; Sessional hymns of the feast; Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi] of Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Hear, O daughter" [LXX Ps. 44:11]; Verse: "My heart hath poured forth a good word" [LXX Ps. 44:2]. Let every breath. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 1:39–49, 56]; after the Gospel, Psalm 50; Sticheron of the feast. Two canons, Tone 4 of George, and Tone 1; the heirmoi twice, and the troparia on 12; Katavasia: "Christ is born", both choirs together. After Ode 3, Hypakoe of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the feast, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Lifted Up upon the Cross" (Вознесыйся):*
invocations.prescribed_model: Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *On the 26th day: Our Venerable Father Alypius the Stylite; Alleluia. Troparion, Tone 1: "A pillar of patience wast thou...". Kontakion, Tone 8, Podoben: "As First-Fruits of Nature" (Яко начатки естества):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6; Katavasia: "Christ is born". After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the Highest" (Вышних ища):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *On the 4th day: The Holy Great-Martyr Barbara, and our Venerable Father John of Damascus. At Vespers: Stichera of both on 6; Glory, Tone 6: "Emulating the fatherland of Abraham..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 6: "Venerable father..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion: "Thy lamb, O Jesus, cries with a loud voice..."; Glory, Tone 8: "Guide of Orthodoxy..."; Both now, Theotokion. At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos on 4, of the saint [Barbara] on 6, and to John on 4. After Ode 3, Kontakion [of St. Barbara], Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Lifted Up upon the Cross" (Вознесыйся):*
invocations.prescribed_model: Thou Who wast lifted up upon the Cross
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *On the 6th day: Our Father among the Saints Nicholas, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia; we celebrate all day. At Vespers: "Blessed is the man"; stichera of the saint on 8, Tone 2, Podoben: "When from the Tree" (Егда от дрѣва):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *Glory, Tone 6: "The ornament of the saints..."; Both now, Theotokion 1 of the same tone; Entrance; daily Prokeimenon; 3 Readings as on November 13. At the Aposticha: Idiomela to the saint, or Prosomoia; verses: "Precious in the sight of the Lord..."; "What shall I render..."; Glory, Tone 6: "O man of God..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion, Sessional hymn 2, Tone 4: "A rule of faith...". Customary Kathisma psalmody, and the other prayers; Sessional hymns of the saint; Songs of Ascents of Tone 4; Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord..."; Verse: "What shall I render..."; "Let every breath praise the Lord"; Gospel from John, pericope on the 5th Sunday after Pascha: "At that time..." [Jn. 10:9–16]; Psalm 50; sticheron of the saint. Canon of the Theotokos [Heliodoros] with heirmoi on 6, and of the saint on 8; Katavasia: "Christ is born". After Ode 3, Sessional hymns of the saint; Glory... Both now... Theotokion. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣва днесь):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *On the 11th day: Our Venerable Father Daniel the Stylite. Troparion: "A pillar of patience wast thou..."; Sessional hymn 1; Both now, Theotokion. Kontakion, Tone 8, Podoben: "As First-Fruits of Nature" (Яко начатки):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *On the 12th day: Our Venerable Father Spyridon the Wonderworker, Bishop of Trimythous. At Vespers: Stichera of the saint on 6; Glory, Tone 2: "O hierurg of God..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha of the Octoechos: Glory, Tone 1: "Venerable father..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion, Sessional hymn 2: "A rule of faith...". At Matins: Canons of the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the Highest" (Вышних ища):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *At Matins: Canons of the Octoechos and of the saints. After Ode 3, Kontakion [of St. Eleutherius], Tone 2, Podoben: "The Firm..." (Твердыя):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *On Saturday, at Little Vespers: from the Octoechos, Resurrection and Theotokion according to custom; but the service of the saints which is in the [Menaion] is sung when the superior of the church desires it. At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. On "Lord, I have cried", we sing 3 Resurrection stichera; and of the feast, 4, Tone 2: "Come, let us rejoice..."; and of the saints, 3, Tone 1, Podoben: "Thou who bearest flesh..."; Glory, Tone 6: "Rejoicing, we celebrate [the memory]..."; Both now, Theotokion of the current tone. Entrance according to custom. At the Aposticha: Resurrection sticheron, and the Alphabetical stichera; Glory, Tone 6: "Jerusalem, rejoice..."; Both now, of the feast. Blessing of the loaves; Troparion, Tone 2: "Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos..." twice, and of the saints once:*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Troparion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *At Matins: Troparion of the feast, and of the saints; Glory, of the saint; Both now, of the feast. Sessional hymns of the feast. Canons: of the feast to 6; of the saints to 4; and of the saint to 4. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the saint, Tone 8, Podoben: "To the chosen..." (Въ избраннои):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.normalized_rubric: *And at Matins: Sessional hymns of the Forefeast; Canon of the Forefeast to 6; of the saint to 6. After Ode 3, Kontakion [of the saint], Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou hast appeared today" (Явися):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Kontakion:*

The service is sung... Troparion, Tone 4: "O God of our fathers..."; Glory, Both now, of the feast. At Matins: Canon of the feast and of the saints. After Ode 3, Troparion [Sessional hymn], Tone 1, Podoben: "The angelic choir" (Ликъ ангельскій):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Beholding with the eyes of the soul, O hierarch, thou...

invocations.normalized_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 1, Podoben: "The angelic choir" (Ликъ ангельскій):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Beholding with the eyes of the soul, O hierarch, thou...

invocations.normalized_rubric: *At Matins: we begin chanting 3 Kathismata at Matins, and at Vespers: "In my distress I cried unto the Lord..." [Kathisma 18, LXX Ps. 119–133]. Sessional hymns in the Octoechos. And we recite the biblical canticles by themselves; Canon of the Octoechos to 6, and of the saints two [canons to 8]. After Ode 3, Kontakion, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣва днесь):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Gathering today, let us praise with hymns the unwaning luminary...

invocations.normalized_rubric: *Kontakion, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣва днесь):*
invocations.governed_hymn_opening: *Gathering today, let us praise with hymns the unwaning luminary...

invocations.normalized_rubric: *Glory, Both now, Theotokion. At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man..." [Kathisma 1]. On "Lord, I have cried": Prosomoia, 3, Tone 4, Podoben: "Called from on high" (Званному свыше), on 8; Glory, Tone 6: "According to the image..."; Both now, Dogmatikon Theotokion: "Who would not bless thee...?". Entrance; Prokeimenon; 3 Lections common to venerable monastics. At the Litiya: Idiomela, 3, of the saint, Tone 2; Glory, Tone 5: "O venerable father..."; Both now, Theotokion: "Sing, O ye people...". At the Aposticha: Prosomoia, 3; Glory of the saint, Tone 8: "The multitude of monastics..."; Both now, Theotokion. Blessing of loaves: "Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos..." twice, and of the saint once: "Zealous like Elijah...", and reading of the holy*[^375] *from the Life of the saint. At Matins: Troparion of the saint; Glory, Both now, Theotokion. 3 Kathismata; Sessional hymns of the saint; and the Polyeleos. Sessional hymn of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke, in memory of the 2nd Sunday [Lk. 6:17–23]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]; Sticheron of the saint. Canon of the Mother of God: "Holding fast amidst many [temptations]...", with the heirmos to 6, and of the saint to 8. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn; Glory, Both now, Theotokion.
